name: smwgraphics-trials-of-mana-woods-of-wandara-boss
title: Trials of Mana - Woods of Wandara (Boss)
description:
A pretty detailed background from Trials of Mana previously known as Seiken Densetsu 3.

It's the area where the player fights Mispolm, the Benevodon of the Woods.

This update includes bigger optimizations, saving a lot of space, now it doesn't use the FG2 slot, and most of BG3 space is free for more graphics. Accuracy to the source material also has been improved. Map 16 and palette are significantly better, too.

A good fit for cutscenes, one screen forest rooms or whatever you wish to use it. Please remember that background scrolling should be: None, None.

Originally used in Gacha Trouble, my Questionable Level Design Contest entry.
